sessions.phase_label: SEO assessment, plan negotiation, and trial scope confirmation
Keyword research, blog planning, and on-page recommendations
Blog production, review, publication, and webpage content updates
Remaining blog delivery, backlink indexing, and on-page completion
Indexing review and final SEO reporting

requirements.title: Campaign Keyword Selection
requirements.definition: Research, maintain, and apply the client-approved campaign keyword set, including the agreed keyword count and requested term or page-mapping replacements.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers selection and revision of target terms; search-volume data and blog-specific topic planning are independently deliverable behaviors.

requirements.title: Keyword Search Volume Data
requirements.definition: Include search-volume metrics for keywords in the keyword research sheet or report.
requirements.boundary_note: Search-volume reporting can be missing or corrected independently of whether the keyword set itself is approved.

requirements.title: Blog Production and Publication
requirements.definition: Prepare and publish the agreed number of SEO blog articles through the client-review and publication workflow.
requirements.boundary_note: Article count, cadence, review, and publication are attributes of one delivery workflow; article media, links, length, topics, and audience rules remain independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Blog Topic and Keyword Selection
requirements.definition: Propose and revise blog topics and associated blog keywords according to client feedback.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers editorial topic and blog-keyword choices, not the broader campaign keyword sheet or the production and publication of finished articles.

requirements.title: AI Dolls Blog Audience Targeting
requirements.definition: Target the AI dolls article primarily toward Gen Z young people rather than children.
requirements.boundary_note: This article-specific audience rule can be revised independently of general topic selection and blog formatting.

requirements.title: Relevant Images in Blog Articles
requirements.definition: Include relevant images in published blog articles, with later guidance specifying approximately three to four images per article.
requirements.boundary_note: Image inclusion has its own acceptance criterion and can succeed or fail independently of internal linking and article length.

requirements.title: Internal Links in Blog Articles
requirements.definition: Embed relevant keyword-based internal links from blog articles to site products and related content.
requirements.boundary_note: Internal linking is independently reviewable and is not merged with blog images or article word count.

requirements.title: Blog Article Word Count
requirements.definition: Make each applicable blog article exceed approximately 1,500 words where practicable.
requirements.boundary_note: Article length is a separate acceptance criterion from images, links, topics, and publication timing.

requirements.title: Blog Topic and Keyword Document
requirements.definition: Provide a document listing blog topics and their associated keywords.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested document is an independently requested artifact rather than the topic-selection behavior itself.

requirements.title: Guest Post Delivery
requirements.definition: Include guest-post work in the proposed SEO engagement unless later excluded by the confirmed trial scope.
requirements.boundary_note: Guest posting is independently selectable and negotiable from site blogs and backlink creation; the final visible trial list omits it, but exact lifecycle treatment requires event-level review.

requirements.title: Meta Title and Description Optimization
requirements.definition: Correct and optimize website meta titles and meta descriptions as part of on-page SEO.
requirements.boundary_note: The website changes are distinct from the later requirement to deliver a before-and-after record of those changes.

requirements.title: Heading Structure Optimization
requirements.definition: Correct multiple H1 tags and improper heading structures identified in the website's on-page SEO.
requirements.boundary_note: Heading correction has an independent implementation and completion check from image ALT, metadata, and sitemap work.

requirements.title: Image ALT Attribute Optimization
requirements.definition: Add or improve missing image ALT attributes as part of on-page SEO.
requirements.boundary_note: Image ALT work is independently confirmable and should not be merged into a broad on-page SEO umbrella lifecycle.

requirements.title: Sitemap Correction and Search Console Submission
requirements.definition: Correct sitemap errors and ensure the sitemap is successfully submitted and processable in Google Search Console.
requirements.boundary_note: Sitemap correction has its own implementation and runtime-processing evidence, separate from metadata, headings, and image ALT work.

requirements.title: Webpage Keyword Content Update
requirements.definition: Revise webpage content and keyword placements according to client feedback and approval.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers ordinary webpage-content revisions; the Back to School landing page has a separate editing path and client-side handoff.

requirements.title: Back to School Landing Page SEO Update
requirements.definition: Prepare and apply, or provide for client application, the SEO edits required for the Back to School sale landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: This page uses a distinct Smart Landing Page editing path and later shifts implementation to the client, so it remains separate from general webpage updates.

requirements.title: On-Page SEO Completion Report
requirements.definition: Provide a report documenting the completed on-page SEO work and remaining or updated suggestions.
requirements.boundary_note: This broad on-page completion artifact is distinct from implementing the underlying fixes and from the specific meta-tag before-and-after list.

requirements.title: Meta Tag Before-and-After List
requirements.definition: Provide a before-and-after document or list showing updated meta titles and meta descriptions.
requirements.boundary_note: This review artifact can be delayed or delivered independently of the underlying meta-tag implementation.

requirements.title: Backlink Creation
requirements.definition: Create the agreed backlink set, including the target quantity and the accepted mix of dofollow and nofollow links.
requirements.boundary_note: Backlink quantity and follow-type ratio are attributes of one link-building mechanism; Google indexing and re-indexing have a separate execution trajectory.

requirements.title: Backlink Indexing and Re-indexing
requirements.definition: Submit created backlinks for Google indexing, report their indexing status, and re-submit links that remain unindexed.
requirements.boundary_note: Indexing can fail or remain partial after backlinks have been created, so it is separate from backlink production.

requirements.title: Periodic SEO Work Reporting
requirements.definition: Provide requested weekly, monthly, or final summaries of completed SEO work and progress.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested reporting deliverable; it excludes specialized keyword, indexing, on-page, and meta-tag artifacts.
